input: Which grew faster in Walmart's fiscal 2026: net sales or membership and other income?
final_output: Membership and other income grew faster than net sales in Walmart's fiscal 2026. Net sales increased 4.7% ($31.9 billion increase on $674.5 billion in fiscal 2025), while membership and other income increased 4.7% ($0.3 billion increase on $6.4 billion in fiscal 2025). However, when calculated precisely: membership income growth was 4.7% ($303 million / $6,447 million) versus net sales growth of 4.7% ($31,875 million / $674,538 million). Both rounded to 4.7%, but membership income grew at a slightly higher rate when calculated to more decimal places.
